pullRequest.title: fix: pair Nova frontend and canonical real permission acceptance
pullRequest.body:
Pair the accepted Nova frontend with exact Bamboo `4a028813b39ff7ef512e4c897e2e1b5e198ab06d` and repair two real-acceptance fixtures exposed by the original pipeline.

Current head `58920d5b58b98847ef10f70e60b8f8c23afb9df4`, tree `ac22ba827f3144ba7d63ae64c748bd46c5eb718e`, normally includes accepted #324/main `12761482c8f5c98a7847aa13e3fa15dedd223080`. Thirteen files,351 insertions/67 deletions. Product `src` tree remains `11b14bbe68753af8beb706bb7a477dd4c3a7616c`, byte-identical to prior13e12176.

CI/runtime/acceptance/docs bind the same backend. The historical recovery test now returns the recovered source's own pins, with four wrong-source rejection cases; production recovery verification is unchanged.

The permission fixture now requests only the offered canonical exec_command with exact cmd/yield_time_ms arguments. Coverage retains configured always-ask under Bypass, pending metadata, no execution before approval or after denial, and one exact completed zero-exit command result under Auto. Placeholders/running/killed/error/truncated/foreign results fail. This passed the prior source's original real suite.

The latest original trace then exposed an HTTP startup network transition: five ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED failures and six abandoned early script requests, while the later same-URL200 loads and UI interactions completed. The local artifact observer correctly failed its unchanged10000ms drain; one active browser frame long poll was also pending. HTTPS did not run. The new fixture first navigates an independent context only to verified /readyz and waits for network idle, for HTTP and HTTPS. It does not load/cache the application or assets. The first actual application document is then observed in a fresh context with all original request/body, HTTP/error/origin/WebSocket/manifest gates. Only the existing bounded ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED/error-page navigation sequence may retry; unrelated failures remain fatal.

Validation:

- Existing preflight extracted without behavior change: new regressions6 failed/7 passed; repaired navigation controls25 passed, including invalid readiness/foreign path/status/JSON, unrelated transport/TLS/timeouts and finite transition cases.
- New real Chromium regression passed on desktop/tablet/phone. It proves readiness visits no app assets, then the first observed app captures its bootstrap, script and owned503 failure. Initial sandbox browser-startup denial is retained separately, not a test execution result.
- Typecheck, focused lint and diff checks passed. Current repair patch SHA256 `73711f47b49f613f33133da5435bf7c3480612b94514d291c88c8f6c747594b6`.
- New exact-source original [run38708312022](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38708312022): Node22/24 each3109 unit+383 browser passed/97 skipped. Real Bamboo116340096348 is running; aggregate acceptance pending. [Code](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/pull/326#issuecomment-6188292727) and [Security](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/pull/326#issuecomment-6188291979) explicitly report no findings for589/base127.

Retained original outcomes:

- [38691982413](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38691982413): two historical fixture assertions failed.
- [38692511271](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38692511271): owner-cancelled before Rust after accepted-main ancestry changed.
- [38693953119](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38693953119),ae124033: Node22/24 each3065 unit+380 browser passed/97 skipped; real phase8P/1F/3skip/1notrun. Provider422 required obsolete Bash; later artifact phase did not run.
- [38700460078](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38700460078),13e12176: Node22/24 each3093 unit+380 browser passed/97 skipped; original real suite10P/3skip. Artifact-local1F/2skip at the drain; HTTPS not run. [Original artifact11958726952](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38700460078/artifacts/11958726952),SHA256 `1352caec5af62d44044f25dc17888e3243c39a0b8135e1fe2ae9cbd8989c9cac`.

Feature boundary: #324's hosted Node22/24 each3061 unit+380 browser passed, local Nova30/30 passed. Existing Mac full fixture374P/97skip/6F was reproduced on unchanged main and tracked in #325. Actual Nova App startup, desktop permission and MCP adoption remain outside this evidence.

Release checkpoint: fixed frontend backend4a is not a Bamboo release cut. Necessary existing Server repair #1990 is normally accepted; actual dev also normally accepted #1981. No release branch has been frozen. After this exact source passes and normally merges, its immutable tag and a separate reviewed authority record precede one original npm publication, consumer acceptance to dev, and a fresh actual-dev cut. Backend scope checkpoint is cdafa370/tree4c49278b, including normally accepted#1990/#1981. New#1988 and subsequent#896 slices remain excluded until the actual cut exists; their normaldev admission may then proceed immediately in parallel with frozen-release publication. No local Cargo was started by this release task.
